summary: JERONIX desktop: look, apps, login screen, boot splash and terminal
description:
The JERONIX desktop: the GNOME Shell theme and extensions (taskbar, Start menu,
Control Center), JERONIX apps and Settings, wallpapers and icons, the JERONIX login
screen and boot splash, the terminal look, and the Pure layout as system-wide
GSettings defaults. Users can change or reset every setting; removing the package
puts the replaced system files back.
